reason: The agent confirmed the booking without first reading back the name, time, and party size and asking for confirmation.
name: Missing booking confirmation

spec.behavior: You speak naturally and give the time, party size, and name when asked. If they say the booking is confirmed, you thank them and end the call.
spec.policy_under_test: Before booking, the agent must read back the name, time, and party size and ask the caller to confirm.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent reads back the name, time, and party size and asks the caller to confirm before finalizing the booking.
